name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance for Interest Subsidy (Service Sector)
briefDescription: The scheme "Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana" aims to support SC/ST entrepreneurs and strengthen MSMEs, making them globally competitive.
descriptionMd:
The scheme &quot;Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana&quot; is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat. It aims to empower the state&#39;s dynamic MSME sector, which significantly contributes to employment, GDP, and exports. Effective from August 7th, 2020 to August 6th, 2025, this initiative supports SC/ST entrepreneurs and strengthens MSMEs, making them globally competitive.
The component &quot;Assistance for Interest Subsidy (Service Sector)&quot; provides an interest subsidy on the term loan to support micro-enterprises in the service sector.
benefitsMd: > **Financial Assistance:** **Category of Taluka** **Quantum of Incentive** [Category I](https://indextb.com/files/2020/11/a34fc914-6cdd-4fd6-8773-502017da4334_taluka%20category.pdf)8% on Term Loan with a maximum amount of ₹35,00,000/- per annum for a period of 7 years[Category II](https://indextb.com/files/2020/11/a34fc914-6cdd-4fd6-8773-502017da4334_taluka%20category.pdf)7% on Term Loan with a maximum amount of ₹30,00,000/- per annum for a period of 6 years [Category III](https://indextb.com/files/2020/11/a34fc914-6cdd-4fd6-8773-502017da4334_taluka%20category.pdf) &amp;amp; Municipal Corporation Areas6% on Term Loan with a maximum amount of ₹25,00,000/- per annum for a period of 5 years> **Additional Subsidy:** 1% extra interest subsidy for registered startups in the service sector with Udyam/MSME Registration.
eligibilityMd:
- The firm must be a Micro/Small/Medium enterprise run by SC/ST entrepreneur.
  - The enterprise must be a manufacturing enterprise.
  - Only new MSMEs in the service sector (as per [Annexure A and B](https://ic.gujarat.gov.in/documents/commondoc/2020/2-GR_02092020.pdf)) are eligible.  - The enterprise must have a term loan sanctioned for new machinery, equipment, or furniture/fixtures.
  - The loan should be sanctioned within one year before the commencement of commercial production.
  - Enterprises must have proper tax and business registrations.

&gt; **Note:** 

SC/ST Enterprise: SC/ST Enterprise means the enterprise in which contribution of SC/ST entrepreneur is 51% or more.
exclusionsMd:
- Enterprises whose term loan is sanctioned after one year from the commencement of commercial production.
  - Enterprises defaulting on loan repayments as per RBI and bank guidelines.
  - Enterprises seeking reimbursement for penal interest or other bank charges.
  - Enterprises availing interest subsidy under any Central Government scheme where the total subsidy exceeds the total interest paid.
applicationMd:
> **Registration Process:** **Step-1:** Visit the [Investor Facilitation Portal (IFP)](https://ifp.gujarat.gov.in/DIGIGOV/) portal. Click on "New Investor Registration" to access the registration form. **Step-2:** Fill in the Registration Form. Click on "Submit". **Step-3:** Verify the E-mail ID using the link sent on your registered E-mail ID. **Step-4:** After verification, you will be registered successfully.
> **Post-Registration Process:** **Step-1:** Visit the [Investor Facilitation Portal (IFP)](https://ifp.gujarat.gov.in/DIGIGOV/) portal. Click on "Login". **Step-2:** Enter the email address and password you used during registration. **Step-3:** Click the "Login" button to access your account. **Step-4:** Now fill in the required details and mandatory documents about your business to complete the application process.
> **Helpdesk:** [**Contact** ](https://ifp.gujarat.gov.in/DIGIGOV/IFP-pages/contact.jsp?pagedisp=static)
